_instructions: Fill in the fields below, then save this file and press Enter in the init.py terminal.
REQUIRED fields (init.py will not proceed until these are filled): codebase_path, what, dos, donts.
OPTIONAL fields may be left as empty string "". If left empty and marked delegatable,
the interviewer will delegate them to the verifier agent to determine at runtime.
Preserve exact numbers, metric names, and file paths — the interviewer will not invent them.
Lines starting with an underscore key (like this one and the _hint_* keys) are ignored.
_hint_codebase_path: REQUIRED. Absolute path to the target project codebase (must exist).
_hint_what: REQUIRED. The specific research/optimization task an autonomous agent can act on.
_hint_why: OPTIONAL. The motivation / problem driving this work. Leave "" to skip.
_hint_how: OPTIONAL, delegatable. Metric to optimize AND direction (max/min), e.g. 'maximize test_acc'. Leave "" to let the verifier identify it.
_hint_baseline: OPTIONAL, delegatable. Current baseline value for the 'how' metric. Leave "" to let the verifier measure it.
_hint_terminate: OPTIONAL, delegatable. Full-training result that means 'done, auto-research succeeded'. Leave "" to let the verifier decide.
_hint_search_posture: OPTIONAL. One of 'hparam' | 'structural' | 'mixed' (default 'mixed' if empty). Declares whether this project's win is expected from tuning existing knobs ('hparam' — reward careful search, do NOT force method changes), from new methods/formulations/architectures ('structural' — reward literature-grounded novelty, penalize repeated knob tweaks), or both ('mixed'). This governs how hard the planner is pushed away from naive hyperparameter search and toward external knowledge — set it honestly for the task, since it directly tunes the anti-overfit pressure.
_hint_method_priors: OPTIONAL. List of known methods/techniques/baselines worth trying for THIS task (e.g. named regularizers, schedules, loss variants, architecture variants, or task-specific baselines that fit within the allowed edit surface). Seeds the planner's structural-change menu so it need not rediscover the field from scratch. Leave [] to let the planner discover methods via literature search at runtime.
_hint_signal_horizon_hint: OPTIONAL. How long before an experiment reveals whether it is working, in the task's own units (e.g. 'loss trend clear by ~500 steps', 'val metric meaningful only after 1 full epoch', 'penalty effect only visible after the anneal boundary'). Feeds the verifier's kill-early patience so slower-to-emerge structural changes are not killed prematurely. Leave "" to let the verifier infer it from early logs.
_hint_dos: REQUIRED. >=1 always-do rule, e.g. 'always use the davinci conda env', 'always run on a single GPU during debugging'.
_hint_donts: REQUIRED. >=1 never-do rule, e.g. 'never modify the base checkpoint at /path/to/base', 'never push to git'.
